gripOrHq.title: Running Interference
gripOrHq.rulesText: Make a run. During that run, the Corp must pay [X], in addition to the normal cost, to rez each piece of ice, where X is the rez cost of that piece of ice. Playing a double prep costs two consecutive actions this turn instead of one.

gripOrHq.title: The Shell Traders
gripOrHq.rulesText: A: Choose a program or hardware card from your hand. Set that card aside face up, and put a number of Shell counters on it equal to its installation cost. When the last Shell counter on that card has been removed, install that card, at no cost. Remove one Shell counter from one card at the start of each of your turns. [1]: Remove one Shell counter from a card.

heapOrArchives.title: Temple Microcode Outlet
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Search your stack for a program. Show that program to the Corp, and then bring it into your hand. Shuffle your stack afterwards.

heapOrArchives.title: Sneak Preview
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Choose a program from your trash or search your stack for a program. Install that program, at no cost. Shuffle your stack afterwards. At the end of the turn, take the program into your hand.

heapOrArchives.title: Swiss Bank Account
heapOrArchives.rulesText: You may use the following abilities whenever you pay any cost or penalty. [T]: Gain [2]. [3], [T]: Gain [6]. Hidden resources are installed face down, but are put into the trash face up.

heapOrArchives.title: Rent-I-Con
heapOrArchives.rulesText: [1]: Break ice subroutine. At the end of this run, trash Rent-I-Con. [1]: +1 strength

scoreArea.title: Superserum
scoreArea.rulesText: When you score Superserum, remove all Virus counters, and avoid receiving the next two Virus counters Runner gives to you.

rig.title: Invisibility
rig.rulesText: Put [1] from the bank on Invisibility when it is installed. Use this bit only to pay for using icebreakers during runs, but not for using noisy icebreakers. If you use the bit, replace it at the start of your next turn.

root.title: London City Grid
root.rulesText: Runner must pay [1], in addition to the normal cost, to use each subroutine of a noisy icebreaker during runs on this fort. Rez a region when you install it. Install a region only if you can pay to rez it. Only one region may be installed in each fort. Trash older ones.

ice.title: Dumpster
ice.rulesText: Dumpster cannot be installed on the Archives. *Runner is now encountering the outermost piece of rezzed ice on the Archives, instead of passing Dumpster. The run is now considered to be a run on the Archives. If there is no rezzed ice on the Archives, Runner is considered to have passed the last piece of ice on the Archives.

root.title: Satellite Monitors
root.rulesText: At the start of each of your turns, you may roll a die for each run Runner made during his or her last turn. For each 1, give Runner a tag.
